title: Crawler revamp, W2 finished: changed phones and hours, and live duplicates
why: decisions/0160 W2, review E24. (1) A listing's own website that now shows a different phone or different hours was never noticed (the refresh only filled empty fields). The worker now sends what the site plainly says (one phone, its hours); a difference goes to Review as a fix with the new values filled in, never written by itself, and the same value is asked about once (site_said). (2) Two live listings that are one business were found only when a visitor said so. The listings tick now finds them (the same phone, with the same Google place, or the same ZIP with the same name or street address; a number shared by more than 4 listings proves nothing) and offers each pair in Review as Same business, at most 40 waiting, a pair never asked twice. (3) The crawler's own Review items were capped like a visitor's (12 a day), so the 13th was lost: the site's own checks are no longer counted against that limit. Insights -> Crawler shows what W2 has waiting in Review. No database update. The worker half (2.2: it sends what the site says) merges to main after this is live; until then nothing changes for refreshes.
